context: Tests whether autoreview reads every authoritative task source, distills acceptance criteria and non-goals, passes that contract to the reviewing model, and blocks rather than guessing when context is unavailable or contradictory.

checklist.name: All authoritative sources read
checklist.description: The plan reads and identifies the merge request, BILL-123 ticket, and payment-idempotency spec before invoking autoreview

checklist.name: Task contract distilled
checklist.description: The task contract includes duplicate-click prevention, retry restoration after failure, and the no-architecture-redesign boundary

checklist.name: Task context passed to helper
checklist.description: The exact helper command supplies the task contract through --prompt, --prompt-file, or --dataset rather than reviewing only the branch diff

checklist.name: Correct branch target
checklist.description: The command reviews the branch against origin/main and does not use empty local mode

checklist.name: Implementation conformance required
checklist.description: The reviewer is explicitly asked to verify every acceptance criterion and report concrete omissions or contradictions, not only inspect code quality

checklist.name: Missing context blocks review
checklist.description: The plan stops and reports a blocker if a named authoritative source cannot be read or conflicts with another source

checklist.name: No invented requirements
checklist.description: The plan does not invent acceptance criteria beyond the supplied sources
